fit_reason: Whole car, a 2008 Toyota Matrix hatchback, listed by a private owner.
findings: Dirty rubber floor mat with dried mud and debris on the driver's side floor
Papers and items left in the front center console area
Dusty, dull-looking cloth on the front and rear seats
Dusty dash and steering wheel area
Paint on the side panels looks somewhat flat in the passenger side photo
Faded, dull lower rocker trim along the passenger side

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Matrix. The driver's floor mat has a fair amount of dried mud, and there are a few items in the front console that show up in the photos. We do mobile pre-sale details, interior and exterior, and can come to you so it photographs cleaner for buyers. Would you like a quote?
